CREATE TABLE products (
    id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name        TEXT   NOT NULL,
    price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (price_cents >= 0),
    stock       INT    NOT NULL CHECK (stock >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id         TEXT        NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key TEXT        NOT NULL,
    status          TEXT        NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSED', 'FAILED')),
    total_cents     BIGINT      NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (user_id, idempotency_key)
);

CREATE TABLE order_items (
    order_id         UUID   NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id),
    product_id       BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id),
    quantity         INT    NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    unit_price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);

CREATE TABLE outbox (
    id              BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id        UUID        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders (id),
    status          TEXT        NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'DONE', 'FAILED')),
    attempts        INT         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_error      TEXT,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- 只索引還要處理的工作,處理完的不佔索引
CREATE INDEX outbox_due ON outbox (next_attempt_at) WHERE status = 'PENDING';
EOF

cat > $B/OrderRepository.kt <<'EOF'
package com.example.order

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.UUID

data class Product(val id: Long, val name: String, val priceCents: Long, val stock: Int)

data class OrderItem(val productId: Long, val quantity: Int, val unitPriceCents: Long)

data class Order(
    val id: UUID,
    val userId: String,
    val status: String,
    val totalCents: Long,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    val items: List<OrderItem>,
)

@Repository
class OrderRepository(private val jdbc: JdbcClient) {

    fun insertProduct(name: String, priceCents: Long, stock: Int): Long =
        jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO products (name, price_cents, stock) VALUES (:n, :p, :s) RETURNING id")
            .param("n", name).param("p", priceCents).param("s", stock)
            .query(Long::class.java).single()

    fun findProduct(id: Long): Product? =
        jdbc.sql("SELECT id, name, price_cents, stock FROM products WHERE id = :id")
            .param("id", id)
            .query { rs, _ -> Product(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getString("name"), rs.getLong("price_cents"), rs.getInt("stock")) }
            .optional().orElse(null)

    /** 不上鎖的讀取,只拿價格;庫存的判斷留給 [deductStock]。 */
    fun findPrices(productIds: Collection<Long>): Map<Long, Long> =
        jdbc.sql("SELECT id, price_cents FROM products WHERE id = ANY(:ids)")
            .param("ids", productIds.toTypedArray())
            .query { rs, _ -> rs.getLong("id") to rs.getLong("price_cents") }
            .list().toMap()

    /**
     * 新建訂單;同一個 (user, key) 已存在時什麼都不寫、回傳 false。
     * 另一個交易正在寫同一個 key 時,這句會等它結束,所以重複請求會在這裡排隊,碰不到庫存。
     */
    fun insertOrderIfAbsent(id: UUID, userId: String, key: String, totalCents: Long): Boolean =
        jdbc.sql(
            """
            INSERT INTO orders (id, user_id, idempotency_key, status, total_cents)
            VALUES (:id, :u, :k, 'PENDING', :t)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
            """,
        ).param("id", id).param("u", userId).param("k", key).param("t", totalCents)
            .update() == 1

    fun insertItems(orderId: UUID, items: List<OrderItem>) {
        // 一次一筆的批次寫入量很小(單筆訂單品項上限 50),逐筆即可,避免多一層批次 API
        items.forEach {
            jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_cents) VALUES (:o, :p, :q, :u)")
                .param("o", orderId).param("p", it.productId).param("q", it.quantity).param("u", it.unitPriceCents)
                .update()
        }
    }

    fun insertOutbox(orderId: UUID) {
        jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO outbox (order_id, status) VALUES (:o, 'PENDING')").param("o", orderId).update()
    }

    /**
     * 防超賣的核心:判斷與扣減在同一句 SQL 裡由資料庫原子完成。
     * 回傳 false 代表庫存不足(這句沒改任何列)。
     */
    fun deductStock(productId: Long, quantity: Int): Boolean =
        jdbc.sql("UPDATE products SET stock = stock - :q WHERE id = :id AND stock >= :q")
            .param("q", quantity).param("id", productId)
            .update() == 1

    fun findOrderByKey(userId: String, key: String): Order? =
        jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM orders WHERE user_id = :u AND idempotency_key = :k")
            .param("u", userId).param("k", key)
            .query(UUID::class.java).optional().orElse(null)
            ?.let { findOrder(it) }

    fun findOrder(id: UUID): Order? {
        val head = jdbc.sql("SELECT id, user_id, status, total_cents, created_at FROM orders WHERE id = :id")
            .param("id", id)
            .query { rs, _ ->
                Order(
                    rs.getObject("id", UUID::class.java), rs.getString("user_id"), rs.getString("status"),
                    rs.getLong("total_cents"), rs.getTimestamp("created_at").toInstant(), emptyList(),
                )
            }
            .optional().orElse(null) ?: return null
        val items = jdbc.sql("SELECT product_id, quantity, unit_price_cents FROM order_items WHERE order_id = :id ORDER BY product_id")
            .param("id", id)
            .query { rs, _ -> OrderItem(rs.getLong("product_id"), rs.getInt("quantity"), rs.getLong("unit_price_cents")) }
            .list()
        return head.copy(items = items)
    }
}
EOF
